reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount and routes the four midpoint copies through it, though each site still wraps the call in its own missing/number dispatch that the helper already handles.

duplication.why: The midpoint arithmetic copies are removed, but the `== null ? 0 : typeof === 'number' ? v : helper(v)` dispatch, which getScheduledAmount already performs, is left repeated at four call sites.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the module where scheduled-amount logic already sits.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, comments and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule is now mostly in one function, but schedule-template.ts still computes its own midpoint, so budgeting templates silently disagree with the rest of the app.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The edited sites call getScheduledAmount; the remaining bypass in budget/schedule-template.ts is pre-existing and left untouched (see one_place).

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is re-expressed in a new shape; the leftover per-site dispatch is the original code kept as is.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount holds the new rule, but packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/schedule-template.ts (scheduleAmount for op 'isbetween') still computes the midpoint itself and was not changed.
